hero.title: Discover the Heart of Argentine Tango

about.title: About Maria
about.description:
I am a tango dancer and the creator of [BOLD]The Authentic Tango Experience,[/BOLD] a cultural immersion I have been developing for nearly ten years.

 I fell in love with tango the very first night I stepped into a milonga. What began as a fascination with the dance gradually became an essential [BOLD]part of my life.[/BOLD] Over the years, I have [BOLD]written a [BOOK_LINK]book of short stories[/BOOK_LINK] set in milongas,[/BOLD] documented this world through photography and [BOLD]shaped this experience from the desire to show tango from the inside—as a living, deeply rooted cultural expression.[/BOLD]

 Throughout our time together,[BOLD] my role will be to guide you into the world of tango[/BOLD] and the place where it is socially danced—[BOLD]the milonga.[/BOLD] With clarity, depth, and sensitivity, I´ll [BOLD]help you understand its codes and etiquette, its music and history, and the emotional language of the embrace as it unfolds in a real milonga, so tango becomes readable, human, accessible, and deeply meaningful.[/BOLD]

private.title: Discover the Soul of Buenos Aires: A Tango Cultural Walking Tour & a Milonga Experience
private.description:
Go beyond the tourist shows on a tango walking tour that reveals the authentic culture few visitors ever experience. Explore iconic landmarks, uncover the stories and traditions behind Argentina's most emblematic art form, and step into a traditional milonga to witness locals dancing in their own world.

This is not a dance lesson — it's a cultural immersion. Guided by an expert tango guide, dancer, and teacher, you'll discover the codes, rituals, music, and magic that make tango a living part of Buenos Aires.
private.includes: Included: English & Spanish guide, glass of wine/soda/coffee, milonga entry
itinerary: Meet in an iconic area of Buenos Aires and begin exploring the city through the fascinating world of tango.
Walk along tango-related streets and discover hidden tango spots, iconic landmarks, and stories that reveal the history and soul of this unique cultural expression.
Visit an authentic social milonga where locals meet and experience tango from the inside, where locals and dancers come together to share their passion.
Discover the hidden codes of social tango, including etiquette, customs, and rituals, with an expert tango guide who is also a dancer and a teacher.

customizedTours.title: Customized Tours
customizedTours.description:
An [BOLD]immersive cultural proposal[/BOLD] in Buenos Aires, centered on [BOLD]tango as a living social and cultural expression[/BOLD].

The experience invites participants to discover one of the most representative expressions of [BOLD]porteño identity[/BOLD] through historical context and direct contact with [BOLD]authentic tango spaces: the milongas[/BOLD]. Depending on the group’s interests, the program may include a [BOLD]shared or private tango class[/BOLD], offering an approachable and memorable way to engage with the experience.

More than a tourist activity, this is a [BOLD]fun and welcoming cultural experience that makes tango accessible to everyone—especially if you think you can’t dance.[/BOLD]

Designed for [BOLD]educational institutions, universities, corporate groups, international delegations, and cultural exchange programs[/BOLD], the experience is [BOLD]flexible and adaptable[/BOLD] in duration, depth, and format.

An [BOLD]authentic cultural encounter[/BOLD] that allows participants to understand Buenos Aires from the inside and connect with tango, its [BOLD]most vibrant expression[/BOLD].

ebook.title: Discover the inner world of tango through my book Entre La Patagonia y el Tango
ebook.description: Born from a [BOLD]hilarious anecdote[/BOLD], an [BOLD]uncontrollable need to dance tango[/BOLD], and a [BOLD]deep longing for the milonga[/BOLD] while living far away in [BOLD]Patagonia[/BOLD], these stories became my [BOLD]milonguero survival kit[/BOLD]: while my feet walked along [BOLD]Lake Nahuel Huapi[/BOLD], my mind, in [BOLD]high heels[/BOLD], lingered on the [BOLD]dance floors of Buenos Aires[/BOLD], carried by [BOLD]music and embrace[/BOLD].
